skill.summary: Generates changelogs from git commit history using conventional commits. Triggers: generate changelog, release notes, changelog.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of skylv-changelog-generator.

- Generates changelogs from git commit history using conventional commit standards
- Supports changelog triggers including: generate changelog, release notes, changelog
- Organizes logs by feature, fix, documentation, refactor, performance, tests, and maintenance
- Designed for automation and tooling scenarios
